notes:
Public (NYSE: SMR; EDGAR CIK 1822966, ex Spring Valley Acquisition Corp.). Primary evidence: EDGAR 8-K/424B5/10-K documents (snapshots archived under source ledger-nuscale-power; submissions index 377c05a5fc1e) and USAspending award detail JSON. SPAC: Spring Valley IPO (2020-11-27, $230M gross) and the PIPE ($235M, 23,700,002 shares, 8-K 2022-05-05; an earlier 8-K of 2021-12-14 stated $211M for 21,300,002 shares, later upsized) are recorded with amount_kind duplicate because the only figure the closing 8-K gives for cash that reached NuScale LLC is the $145,497,965 gross proceeds contribution (event nuscale-spac-closing-2022-05), and the filings do not say how trust cash, redemptions, PIPE and fees reconcile. Reviewer: do not sum IPO + PIPE + closing. ATM programmes: one event per programme, amount is the ceiling (qualifier up_to), not proceeds. Each later programme terminated or replaced the earlier one (Nov 2025 and Feb 2026 424B5 say the prior ATM was terminated; Aug 2026 424B5 says all shares under the Feb 2026 programme were sold, snapshot c769111f729c). VERIFIER: ATM programme events are amount_kind ceiling (never counted); realised proceeds are separate new_money events: FY2025 gross $1,327.6M across the 2024, Q3 2025 and Q4 2025 programmes (10-K) and about $1B for the fully sold Feb 2026 programme (Aug 2026 424B5). Sales under the Aug 2023 programme and 2024-calendar sales under the Nov 2024 programme are not evidenced (FY2023/FY2024 10-Ks not archived). S-3 shelf of $500M (File 333-272342, 2023-06) is a shelf, not a programme, and is not recorded as an event; S-1/S-3 resale registrations (2022-2023) raise no company money. 2025-07-31 Exchange and Lock-Up Agreement with Fluor (8-K 0001104659-25-072905) limits Fluor sell-down; not funding. Fluor Enterprises is the largest stockholder (about 70.9% of Class B economic interest at closing per 8-K); Fluor sells down. Pre-SPAC private rounds (Fluor, JGC/IHI via Japan NuScale Innovation, Doosan, JBIC, Samsung C&T) are not evidenced beyond the 2011 Fluor convertible notes; not found in the sources archived. Japan NuScale Innovation LLC and JBIC letter agreement (2022-04-04) exists as an exhibit but has no stated amount. DOE: USAspending lists five DOE-NE cooperative agreements to NUSCALE POWER LLC (UEI PNKLRKV4CNX3) obligating $585.9M in total (224.48M + 7.52M + 48.0M + 43.2M + 262.66M). The 10-K (filed 2026-02-26) says "more than $578.3 million from DOE under a series of cost-share programs" (cumulative event, not new money). The two figures differ by about $7.6M and are kept as separate evidenced facts: USAspending obligations (per award) vs the company statement; do not sum them. DE-NE0000633 shows total_funding 278,454,086.42 against total_obligation 224,479,988.42 and non_federal_funding 0; USAspending outlays for DE-NE0000633 and DE-NE0008742 are 0, so disbursed_usd omitted for those. USAspending recipient total for DOE FY2020-26 is $263,815,721.69 under NUSCALE POWER LLC (probe snapshot de63a59b9509), which matches DE-NE0008928 plus nothing older (older awards pre-date the FY2020 window). CFPP: DE-NE0008935 (recipient CFPP LLC, UEI J2Z4L77MTJN7, a UAMPS entity, NOT NuScale) obligated $164,741,352, outlays $145,479,549.39, non_federal_funding $6,674,014,797 (a project-cost figure, not DOE money) per USAspending detail. It funds the NuScale-based Carbon Free Power Project. VERIFIER: the event for this award was REMOVED because the recipient is CFPP LLC (UAMPS), a different legal entity, and the USAspending record does not name NuScale as recipient or beneficiary; evidence stays at snapshot c860ee0c4152 (total_obligation 164741352.0, total_account_outlay 145479549.39, recipient_name CFPP LLC) for attribution to CFPP LLC. The Carbon Free Power Project was wound down (Release Agreement 2023-11-07). NOT FOUND / BLOCKED: DOE press announcements (e.g. the DOE-announced CFPP cost-share ceiling, NuScale FOA awards) could not be fetched: WebSearch budget exhausted and guessed energy.gov URLs returned 404 (snapshots d7fd7867ac54, b6d1a22c28be, b464f04405631, 09e2c3455480, 765164edda0d, d3446b783462 are 404 pages and unused). So the USAspending-vs-DOE-announcement comparison is only USAspending vs the company 10-K. TVA newsroom returned 403 (da4d1f729171); the TVA/ENTRA1 agreement is evidenced through NuScale's 10-K only, and NuScale is not a party to it. ENTRA1 Energy is NuScale's exclusive global strategic partner; the PMA contribution ($35M-$55M) is paid BY NuScale to ENTRA1 energy projects in milestone tranches, so it is an agreement value, not funding received. Dates for the 10-K cumulative events use the auditor-report date (2026-02-26), which equals the filing date.
MERGE 2026-10-05 (USAspending supplement): no new awards. USAspending 'Total Outlays' is account-level outlay data reported from FY2017/FY2020 onward, so disbursed_usd can understate payments on older awards.
[pass2] PASS2 gap-fill. Searched: EDGAR submissions index (377c05a5fc1e), FY2023 10-K, FY2024 10-K, Q1 and Q2 2026 10-Qs (all archived under source ledger-nuscale-power). Added realised ATM gross proceeds the first pass could not evidence: calendar 2023 ($10.4M, Aug 2023 programme), calendar 2024 ($139.0M completing the Aug 2023 $150M programme and $71.2M under the Nov 2024 $200M programme). These are all 2023-2024; the existing FY2025 event ($1,327.6M) covers year ended Dec 2025 so no overlap. Note: the 2023 sales ($10.4M) plus 2024 prior-programme sales ($139.0M) sum to the $150M programme, so the 2023 and 2024 prior-programme events are separate years of one programme, not duplicates.
Confirmation, not added as an event (would duplicate nuscale-atm-sales-2026-02-programme, approx $1B): Q2 2026 10-Q (snapshot e390e7156758) states that in the six months ended June 30, 2026 the Company sold 89,727,165 shares for gross proceeds of $1.0 billion and net $984.5 million (weighted average $11.14) before completing the 2026 ATM Program in June 2026; Q1 2026 10-Q (14a2e739faf0) states $37.9M gross in Q1. Net $984.5M. The Aug 2026 $750M programme has no sales evidenced yet in filings held (Q2 10-Q predates it).
Not found: pre-SPAC private rounds (NuScale Power LLC was funded by Fluor via contributions; no separate round evidenced); Fluor sell-down proceeds go to Fluor, not the company. No DOE press pages retrievable.
